<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Staff are unsure if their roles properly grant access to adjust reserves, leading to uncertainty and potential errors. This matters because incorrect permissions can block legitimate changes or allow unauthorized ones before payment triggers.

## Who is affected
- A large commercial insurer, Marrowgate Commercial, whose staff want to ensure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].
- A cyber insurance customer, Ormsgill Cyber, whose staff are under the impression they have the right role but suspect a possible misconfiguration [i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca].
- A fleet mutual insurer, Harrowfield Fleet Mutual, whose staff are specifically concerned with how roles affect who can adjust reserves before payment triggers [i:f6f76c5dbb558280].

## Evidence
The problem has been raised by 3 accounts in total, across 2 different routes [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca][i:f6f76c5dbb558280]. Sales conversations have generated 2 of the 3 total mentions, and support conversations have generated 1 mention [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca][i:f6f76c5dbb558280]. The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the accounts where ARR is known is £1,735,000.0 [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca]. One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12, and there has been 1 renewal across all accounts in the last 90 days [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].

## Why now
The issue is active and unresolved, with the most recent mention occurring on 2026-10-28 [i:f2b4bc4061ee48ca]. The concern spans different types of insurance customers (commercial, cyber, fleet) and has been raised in both sales and support contexts, indicating it is a cross-functional and ongoing point of confusion. With a key account, Marrowgate Commercial, renewing on 2026-12-12, clarity on role configuration is a timely concern [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].",
  "citations": ["8b9b09ae561d0188", "f2b4bc4061ee48ca", "f6f76c5dbb558280"]
}
